confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Indian metro pricing, not live listings. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, and alcohol prices carry high uncertainty because of state taxes and venue variation. The FX value comes from a search-result summary of RBA data; I did not open the RBA page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: large Indian tech-hub cities with similar restaurant and hotel price levels. Cocktail and wine anchors were set relative to the beer anchor because direct local knowledge of bar prices is weaker.
